manifest.author: RAPP
manifest.description: Builds new RAR agents from a natural-language spec — plans, writes pytest tests, generates code via the Copilot CLI, iterates, and publishes.

args.spec: An agent that fetches the top stories from Hacker News and summarizes them

manifest.name: @rapp/fleet_commander

action.description: Pipeline stage. 'plan' produces a spec. 'test' writes pytest cases. 'build' generates the agent. 'run' executes tests and iterates. 'publish' pushes to RAR. 'full' runs the entire pipeline end-to-end.

agent_name.description: PascalCase name for the agent (auto-generated if omitted).

plan_json.description: JSON plan from a prior 'plan' step (used by build/test).

spec.description: Natural-language description of the agent to build.
